sampleInterval.deltaSemantics: after-minus-before for cumulative metrics; interval statistic for mean/p99/CPU

outlierPolicy.rationale: Each summary group aggregates exactly one sample per trial, and the trial count is 3. Discarding any observation would leave two, which is too few to bootstrap a median confidence interval from. Every sample is therefore retained, and this field records that as a decision rather than leaving it to be inferred from the absence of an exclusion list.

execution.strategy: Measurement is ordered trial-major, then workload, then mode, with the mode sequence rotated by trial index. Consecutive units therefore differ in mode, so drift in machine state over the run is spread across the arms instead of landing on whichever arm ran last.

structurallyUnreachable.reason: A single session is either visible or hidden, so single-active and all-active are the same point; there is no second visibility level to measure.
